senses.gloss:
मौंज a. (जी f.) [मुंज-अण्]
Made of Munja grass (also मौंजक).

मौंजी The girdle of a Brāhmaṇa
made of a triple string of Munja
grass; Ku. 5. 10; Ms. 2. 42.
--Comp.
[]
--निबंधनं, --बंधनं binding on the
Munja grass girdle, investiture with
the sacred thread; Ms. 2. 27, 169.

1 Shaving of the head,
tonsure.
--2 Baldness.

मौनं [मुनेर्भावः अण्] Silence,
taciturnity; मौनं सर्वार्थसाधनं; मौनं त्यज
‘open your lips’; मौनं समाचार
‘hold your tongue’.
--Comp.
--मुद्रा
the attitude of silence.
--व्रतं a vow
of silence.

मौनिन् a. (नी f.) [मौनमस्यास्ति इनि]
Observing a vow of silence, silent,
taciturn; Bg. 12. 19. --m. A holy
sage, an ascetic, a hermit.
